name_zh: 参考帧的误差传播选择
formal_object: Eligible anchor a, anchor-error covariance Sigma_a, local output sensitivities J_ta and later error eta_t; actual per-anchor cost k_a.

operations.output: Separate propagated common error from later errors

operations.input: Frozen decoder around each legal anchor
operations.condition: Differentiability holds in the chosen neighborhood

operations.input: Choose among finite anchors under declared cost
operations.condition: Risk/cost surrogate is actually estimated on allowed evidence

derivation_steps.statement: For uncorrelated centered eta and e_a, E||e_t||^2=tr(J_ta Sigma_a J_ta^T)+E||eta_t||^2 plus controlled remainder.
derivation_steps.justification: Expand the local model; independence/cross-covariance cannot be omitted without the stipulated condition.

derivation_steps.statement: For distinct times t!=s, shared anchor error induces Cov(e_t,e_s)=J_ta Sigma_a J_sa^T when later noises are mutually independent and uncorrelated with the anchor.
derivation_steps.justification: Propagate the same random anchor term through both times; at t=s retain the later-noise covariance.

derivation_steps.statement: If E||rho_t||^2<=r_t^2 for the omitted remainder, |R_actual-R_linear|<=2 sqrt(R_linear) r_t+r_t^2.
derivation_steps.justification: Expand the additional cross term and use Cauchy-Schwarz; a numerical bound is not supplied by the model.

derivation_steps.statement: Select a minimizing the declared sum of local risk proxies plus lambda k_a, subject to the same finite generation budget.
derivation_steps.justification: The optimum is over a finite declared anchor set, not an unobserved population.

assumptions: True Sigma and remainder bounds are not automatically calibrated by decoder perturbations.
If later noise correlates with anchor error, its cross terms must be retained.
Every selected anchor must still generate all original frame IDs and eligible temporal context.
Additional anchor reconstructions are paid in total compute; baseline gets the same search allowance.
method_expression: Estimate a bounded anchor-risk proxy from allowed model/input evidence, choose one anchor prospectively and generate the complete animation.
distinguishing_prediction: Sensitivity-weighted risk should predict downstream degradation better than reference-frame confidence alone; benefit should diminish when anchor sensitivities are alike.
falsifier: Reject if an equal-budget simple image-quality/visibility selector or fixed anchor matches the native result, or estimated anchor risk does not transfer.
closest_alternative: Classical optimal experimental design and anchor selection; first-frame ActionMesh and a simple legal image-quality selector.
decisive_comparison: Fixed anchor versus simple selector versus sensitivity-risk selector with identical finite anchor/search budget and full native scoring.
operational_delta: Explicit propagation and correlated-time error, rather than arbitrary changing of anchor index; real costs and calibration remain unknown.
feasibility_and_cost: Multiple Stage-0 reconstructions/Jacobian probes are expensive on 2080 Ti; reserve until cheaper selected mechanisms are resolved.
structural_signature: Finite anchor-design decision using a propagated error/cost model.
algebra_review_basis: Retained the uncorrelated-noise condition and remainder. No claim that reference quality alone proves downstream quality.
empirical_status: Not implemented in this round; no native method comparison or outcome.
originality_status: Unadjudicated. Classical tools and historical related code are explicitly attributed.
